This game is really fun! it might be in early access but it already has a ton of things to do. There is PVP, but that can be asynchronous with the armies of other people or real time if you find someone to battle with. Since it is an auto battler, what you will be doing is creating synergies of abilities for the units in your deck and managing the formations and tactics before the battle. the roguelite part is how you get units in the map phase. Most units follow a rock paper scissor system but there are special units that have specific purposes such as siege units and infantry. The goal would be to take the castle of the opponent or at least make it so your castle is in better condition at the end of the rounds. And the battles are exiting to see because even if they might seem close the stratagems are the things that will give you and edge and you can see how everything plays out in the battlefield. Because the battles are short it does not feel like you wasted your time even if you lose. If you play in English, There are some small UI parts that might still be in Japanese but the translation and all the info you need to play is there. And the DLC its really just a time saver because u can get everything ingame except the bonuses which are just cosmetics for your profile banner.

Sangokushi BOND is a spiritual successor of Sangokushi Taisen, a RTS arcade game featuring physical collectible card as medium to summon the warlord into the game as well as controller to move / command the said warlord in-game. The gameplay is quite niche and may not for everyone, but it did pretty well on its genre, and if you like the original game, you'll like this. At current state, the game is totally playable and the english translation is done pretty well, however it needs A LOT of improvement: cons: - there's some untranslated part, mostly clickable button so it doesnt matter much - quite grindy and repetitive (I really hope that theres speed up button for siege and not stopping every time warlord evacuating during siege) - no surrender button, if you losing the battle (even against npc), you will have to wait until the very end, including waiting the slow siege - you cant skip the tutorial - discord and other community support mostly in japanese at plus side, this game has decency of not locking content behind dlc aside of some minor cosmetic, as the dlc is more 'pay to unlock stuff faster', and also considering this game regional price is equivalent to playing Sangokushi Taisen THREE times in arcade, it's insta buy for me.

目前感觉还是粉丝向，新鲜感和寿命不会很长。 价格不贵，能开心一会，但是卡池特别的浅，最后流派被限制死。且这个机制自己一般出门只能组三张牌， 剩下是去肉鸽里看脸抓。军师副本在一段后的敌人都是玩家成型的上传存档， 这就导致曲线不是很平衡+局内看脸失败很受挫。 （军师的解锁注意看叹号内容，基本上先去pve爬塔凑盘数更重要，军师影响你结算时能抽到什么角色，流派被打散在不同军师卡池里。建议强度够了再打军师副本。） 而且很多东西没做完，比如重复卡给的几种道具没看到用途等。 不能以卡牌游戏预期来玩，只考虑价格不贵且有兴趣打pve解谜爬塔开荒再入。

這遊戲太看人品了,自己連個2星的黃忠如果沒先編入先發隊的都得看運氣能不能在每一戰的地圖裡抽到,對方卻三星武將隨便有,好不容易靠點運氣和戰略贏了對方有三星隨便可以完虐你的第一場,第二場對方突然就又加一個三星武將根本打不動了.尤其是必須對戰玩家AI隊伍的軍師進階戰到新秀後就上不去了,因為隨便刷都是一推有三星的玩家隊伍. 電腦AI也似乎嚴重作弊,不管是計略傷害,隊伍移動佔位(玩家只有開場可以指示自己隊伍的一次方向移動,開戰之後都是靠AI自動了),電腦方每一場的好武將入手率等都比你有優勢. 武將卡即使被玩家刷到了,也因為編隊COST太低不能好好運用編造自己心儀的隊伍(目前最大好像是4星編隊值,也就是說開場最多放一個3星武將和一個1星武將,或兩個2星,或四個1星等等)之後不管是PVP或PVE開戰都有3場戰鬥,每次戰鬥前可以先走走地圖隨機抽取目前軍師所能登用到的武將,如果像我這樣人品太低抽到的都是爛將或無法配合自己目前陣營和技能發動條件的,就會玩得很自虐. 也懷疑遊戲目前有些系統還沒開放,很多道具拿了都不知道有什麼用,加上目前玩家的編隊COST上限實在是太低無法隨便用自己所喜歡的武將陣容,對戰時電腦又很會作弊,目前覺得玩得很自虐(我沒課金買DLC,所以沒有那些PTW的三星武將,也許買了就容易玩一點了吧),打了幾十場後就覺得玩法很重複又每場還得看人品得重新抽武將玩得有點膩了.還在觀望的還是在等等看之後有開放什麼新系統或玩法再決定要不要入坑吧

Such a nostalgic trip! I used to play the physical Sangokushi Taisen and collect the cards, and it's great to see it back digitally. Although it lacks the real-time physical card movement of the arcade version, the strategy and gameplay are still wonderfully intact. A fantastic digital adaptation!

A friend talked me into trying this — I'm a total beginner, not just to Three Kingdoms games but to the genre itself. I was bracing for it to be complicated, but the tutorial was thorough and I never felt lost, even as a first-timer. Only downside — it dragged on a bit. Maybe a skip option for veterans? I'm also kind of obsessed with the card art — I've already got a few favorite warlords I just love looking at. The more I play, the more I'm getting the hang of the rock-paper-scissors matchups and march orders, and winning feels weirdly satisfying. Planning to keep playing, and I'd recommend it to anyone new to the genre.

游戏性、肉鸽性好评！但是策划自己玩过自己设计的PVE关卡么？游戏难度并非递增式的，往往你会发现通过率30%，4%的关卡只是中段关卡，往往就是这些个别变态关卡卡住了想体验后续心情。希望策划调整关卡难度，可以将大数据中通过率低的关卡放在最后，这样能让玩家体验更多后续因打不过变态关卡不能体验的关卡。另外捉摸不透的抽卡机制，基本每个阵营还差两到三个英雄，可是我已经在战斗中抽到未获得的英雄并从始至终战斗到了终局，结束结算后任然显示未未获得。（曾经有一局连抽到三个稀有英雄并投入战斗，但终局结算页面显示的还是已获得的四个武将，请详细公开武将的获取方式）
